scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/tracker build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/tracker typecheck && bun node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json && bun node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.unit.json
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.check: bun run check:imports && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:boundaries && bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/web/src packages tests scripts apps/web/server.ts
scripts.build:docs: bun run --cwd packages/tracker build && bun run --cwd apps/home build
scripts.storage:up: docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up -d --wait garage && docker compose -f compose.dev.yml run --rm garage-init
